node.statement: Global injectivity: suppose X=U_i bold-dot (J+q_i), U_i in calU and ||q_i||<delta for i=1,2. Expanding X^dagger bold-dot X-J around q_i=0 with bilinearity, the star rule, and the associator/product bounds of def-epsilon-cstar-algebra gives ||X^dagger bold-dot X-J||<=2delta+C*(epsilon_r*delta+delta^2); moreover X is O(delta)-close to U_i, so node 1.1.1 and a Neumann perturbation make L_X invertible, hence X has a right inverse and lies in calUbar_{c*delta} for fixed c=4. Also ||phi_X(U_i)||=||L_X^{-1}(U_i-X)||<2c*delta. Apply lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control at scale c*delta: U_i=X bold-dot(J+a_i+g_X(a_i)) for unique a_i in icalH, and the equality X=U_i bold-dot(J+q_i) says p_X(a_i,q_i)=0. Node 1.2.1 makes p_X injective on this box, so a_1=a_2 and q_1=q_2, hence U_1=U_2. Thus Pi_delta is globally bijective onto S_delta. Its local C^1 inverses glue to (u_delta,h_delta), and the defining equality gives X=u_delta(X) bold-dot h_delta(X). For U in calU, U=U bold-dot J by exact unitality and J lies in B_delta^{calH}(J); uniqueness therefore gives u_delta(U)=U and h_delta(U)=J.
